purpose: Falsifiable implementation-validation vectors for independent assurance evaluation.

does_not_own: Interop Lab admission or promotion decision

fixtures.title: Conforming production named agent
fixtures.rationale: Declaration and evidence are expected to satisfy the selected ANAB target when current and verifiable.

fixtures.title: Stale identity/name binding
fixtures.mutation: binding freshness is outside the relying-party acceptance window
fixtures.rationale: A stale binding cannot support a current name-assurance claim.

fixtures.title: Revoked operator or binding
fixtures.rationale: Positive revocation evidence contradicts the current assurance proposition.

fixtures.title: Missing freshness evidence
fixtures.mutation: freshness/status evidence is absent or unverifiable
fixtures.rationale: Absence of evidence is not evidence of validity and MUST NOT be treated as PASS.

fixtures.title: Assurance overclaim
fixtures.mutation: claimed tier or assurance level exceeds evidence demonstrated by the bundle
fixtures.rationale: The evaluated claim is stronger than the supporting evidence.

fixtures.title: Identity valid; authority unproven
fixtures.mutation: identity/name binding evidence is valid but no action-specific authority evidence is supplied
fixtures.rationale: ANAB identity assurance MUST NOT be interpreted as delegated or action-specific authority.

falsification: If an expected outcome cannot be represented using existing ANAB requirement and evidence semantics, record the concrete gap before changing the normative core.
